question.prompt: Point \(A(1,2)\) is translated 3 units to the right to obtain point \(A'\). Find the coordinates of \(A'\). (Enter the horizontal coordinate first, then the vertical coordinate, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: Translating to the right adds 3 to the horizontal coordinate and leaves the vertical coordinate unchanged, giving \(A'(4,2)\).
solutions.title: Update the horizontal coordinate
